newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Fifty Sri Lankan rebels said killed in sea battle.
newsitem.headline: Fifty Sri Lankan rebels said killed in sea battle.

text.p: Sri Lankan navy patrols chased and sank at least seven Tamil Tiger rebel boats off the northeastern coast early on Wednesday, killing an estimated 50 guerrillas, military officials said.
The seven rebel boats were engaged in a long battle which began late on Tuesday, they said.

The six-hour battle began when a flotilla of navy Dvora fast attack craft on offensive patrol detected and engaged three groups of Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebel boats off Kokkilai, 260 km (160 miles) east of capital Colombo.
"Our Dvoras destroyed one group of boats with at least four boats," a military official said. "We believe at least 50 terrorists would have been killed in the battle," the official said.
Navy attack craft rushed from the eastern navy base at Trincomalee to reinforce those engaged in the mid-sea battle destroyed three more boats of the rebels' Sea Tiger naval wing.
Two weeks ago the Sri Lankan troops launched a fresh offensive against LTTE in the island's north and east, where the rebels are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils.
